title: This stuff REALLY WORKS!
text: This stuff REALLY WORKS!. This stuff works, and the knock off brands are not nearly as effective as the Poo-Pourri.  For years, my office has been directly across the hall from a restroom where initially people would spray so much traditional spray into the air, and I got to smell the funk mixed in with the perfumes.  No more!  Just a few sprays into the toilet prior to #2 really does neutralize the awful poo smell.  Our entire office staff uses this product, and it has also saved my nose on so many occasions traveling.  I HIGHLY recommend Poo-Pourri and have even given it as gift.  If you don't like one scent, try another. This spray REALLY WORKS!
